openings.claim: Envelope pattern/quantity marks and post-insertion ticks may address quantity-memory omissions; exterior pattern marks separately clarify distribution assignment. Rare sample use and shared-material omissions motivate, but do not establish, this explanation.
openings.discriminator: Local loose staging outperforming marked shared-tray kits challenges quantity memory as dominant; correctly ticked incomplete envelopes defeat insertion checking. Compare assignment exchanges separately.
openings.probe: Within 18 minutes including preparation/audit, alternate three matched-mixture four-kit batches: incumbent shared trays, marked/ticked shared trays, and local loose staging. Record crossings, omissions and all elapsed time; audit against samples; stop if staging exceeds table.
openings.uncertainty: Envelope legibility, probe feasibility and full-run timing are unproved. O4 mixture is unknown; omission stage and opened-packet footprint remain unknown.

openings.claim: Reusable tally-sheet maps provide one labelled position per required piece: vacancies expose incomplete picking, leftovers incomplete transfer. Fill positions, transfer, close only when empty, and mark envelope pattern; verify material, dimensions and one piece per position.
openings.discriminator: Matched loose staging with equally few corrections and less time defeats map value; omissions despite completed cycles defeat tracking. Table overflow defeats implementation.
openings.probe: Measure two single-kit maps plus supplies; alternate matched loose/mapped batches within 90 minutes. Count drawing, pattern changes, clearing, replenishment and audit; record vacancies, leftovers, corrections and time.
openings.uncertainty: Sheet space, representation legibility and combined supply/map footprint are unverified. A small batch cannot prove 60-kit success.

lineage.reason: Preserves memory, insertion and assignment relations plus spatial rival.
Preserves physical picking/transfer state and maintenance costs.

decision: Probe both against loose staging; no benefit is established from authored synthetic observations. Require 60 complete pattern-matched kits within 90 minutes, at most one distribution correction, specified quantities/dimensions, exactly two volunteers, existing 180-by-75-centimetre table, envelopes and supplies, and no purchases/equipment.
